$comment: DRAFT v0 — proposed track manifest, not open. Opens only by decision record (0001 model; 0002 k and tolerance). Field names follow the open-benchmark manifests in use by the community benchmarks (see docs/AUTORESEARCH.md §4) so existing solver tooling and self-hosted validators meet the same contract.
name: pqc-agility/T1-verify-single
description: Median single-signature verification time for ML-DSA-65 (S-01) relative to the classical baseline B-01 on the reference CPU class. Calibration track: it exists to make the reference CPU class, the tolerance band, and the runner specification real. It is not the competition and carries no prize.
$minScoreImprovementBips: set equal to the track's reproduction tolerance band by decision record 0002; a promotion inside the tolerance is noise
gates: known-answer tests for the parameter set pass (correctness)
build is pinned: repository, commit, build flags, compiler, container digest recorded in the manifest
no network access during setup or run
result document validates against resultSchema and carries the operator attestation

fixtures.draw: seed = SHA-256(h_fixtures || h_submission || salt_round); h_fixtures = digest of the published fixture bank, h_submission = digest of the canonical submission archive, salt_round = the round secret committed (by hash) before submissions close and revealed with the results. The proposer cannot predict the draw; every node reproduces the same draw.

runner.devRunner: T0 hosted job (GitHub Actions) for pre-flight only; a T0 score is a claimed score, never a promotion

promotion: reproduced on >= k nodes in >= 2 regions within the tolerance band (HARNESS.md §5) AND better than the incumbent by more than minScoreImprovementBips
